roles.admin_text: Everything: sources, users, branding, email, backup, updates and live walls.
roles.editor_in_chief_text: Sees everything including per-editor numbers; builds dashboards, reports and goals.
roles.editor_text: All items and channels plus their own editor numbers; own dashboards and on-demand reports.
roles.staff_text: Views items, channels, followers and goals without editor names.

auth.signInIntro: Use your account to open the statistics platform.
auth.ssoSoon: Microsoft 365 sign-in becomes available in phase 1.
auth.needsSetup: No account exists yet. Open the setup link that the installer printed to create the first administrator.
auth.passwordRule: At least 12 characters. A sentence of a few words works well.
auth.totpHint: The 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

setup.title: Create the first administrator
setup.intro: This account manages the platform. You can add colleagues afterwards.
setup.noToken: This page needs the one-time link printed by the installer. Run: stats-collector setup-link

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyText: The foundation is in place. Connectors for streams, website, video and social media arrive in the next phases.
dashboard.roadmapIntro: What is being built, phase by phase.

p0.title: Foundation
p0.text: Installer, accounts, menu, languages, branding, info and updates, email, backup.

p1.title: Data and streams
p1.text: Data model, background jobs, Owncast and Icecast, first dashboard, Microsoft 365 sign-in.

p2.title: Website and video
p2.text: WordPress plugin, YouTube, articles and editors.

p3.title: Facebook and dashboard builder
p3.text: Facebook and Instagram, stacked and overlaid charts, goals, live wall.

p4.title: Reports
p4.text: Report builder, PDF and interactive HTML, schedules.

info.title: Info & updates
info.subtitle: Installed version, update channel and release notes.
info.upToDate: You are running the newest version for this channel.
info.channelMismatch: You are on a test version. The newest production version is {{version}}; install it below to switch back.

channelHelp.production: Production follows the stable releases from the main branch. Recommended for daily use.
channelHelp.test: Test follows the develop branch: new features first, possibly less stable. Use it on a test server.

info.releasesIntro: What is new, changed, removed and fixed in each version.
info.confirmText: A database backup is made first. The application restarts for a moment; if the new version does not start, the previous version and database are restored automatically.
info.confirmOtherChannel: This version belongs to the other channel.

sso.redirectHint: Add this URI to the app registration under Authentication → Web.

branding.subtitle: Logo, colours and fonts for the app, reports, emails and the live wall.

branding.imported: Brand loaded. Click Save to apply it.
branding.importFailed: This file is not a valid brand file.

email.title: Email
email.subtitle: Your own SMTP server for notifications and reports.
email.noEncryptionWarning: Without encryption passwords and messages travel in plain text. Only use this on a trusted local network.
email.testIntro: Saves the settings and sends a test message.

backup.title: Backup & restore
backup.subtitle: Full and incremental backups of the database and files, copied to your own remote locations.
backup.targetsIntro: Every backup is copied to all enabled locations.
backup.noTargets: No remote location yet: backups stay on this server only.
backup.name: Name
backup.confirmDeleteTarget: Delete this location? Backups already stored there are kept.
backup.ftpWarning: Plain FTP sends the password unencrypted. Prefer FTPS or SFTP.
backup.retentionHint: Older full backups and their incrementals are removed.
backup.passphraseHint: At least 12 characters. Store it safely: you need it to restore on a new server.
backup.passphraseSet: A passphrase is set. Leave empty to keep it.
backup.noEncryption: Without a passphrase backups are stored unencrypted on the remote location.
backup.restoreIntro: Pick a location, load the backups stored there and choose the moment to go back to.
backup.remoteEmpty: No backups found on this location.
backup.confirmRestoreText: The whole database and the files are replaced by the state of {{when}}. Everything entered after that is lost. The application is offline during the restore.

general.subtitle: Organisation, language and time zone.
general.defaultLanguageHint: For new users and emails to external recipients.
general.proxyText: The app listens on port 8080 and trusts forwarded headers only from the proxy IPs in the configuration file. Change them there and restart with: systemctl restart stats-collector-web
